description: Burn styled captions into an existing video. Returns two files: output[0] is the captioned video, output[1] is the original uncaptioned video — so you can re-caption with a different style without regenerating. (A speechless video returns just the original.)

placement.description: Where captions sit. Defaults per style: chunk/highlight → center, subtitle → bottom.

style.description: Caption look. chunk = bold centered word blocks (standard TikTok/Reels). highlight = active word lit in colour (Hormozi/retention). subtitle = clean bottom line (cinematic / YouTube).

name: caption_video

run_id.description: Poll this id with get_run for status + output URLs.
